remarks: Have you been looking for a move-in ready condo in the desirable gated community of Fountain Terrace? Your search is over! This 2 bedroom 1 bath has been tastefully updated. You will love the kitchen's open feel, stainless steel appliances, higher end granite counter top and stylish backsplash. The floors have all been redone leaving a clean and sophisticated look. The completely tiled bathroom with modern vanity is a show stopper! The bedrooms are both of ample size and get great light. The balcony is the perfect place to unwind and get some fresh air. If you need to sweat some stress away, this complex is equipped with a fitness center. It won't be long now until the pool is filled with crystal clear water and surrounded by lush greenery. This condo is super close to the many restaurants, shopping centers, and nightlife that downtown Stamford has to offer.
